hero.label: safe autonomy · learning-based control
hero.title: Autonomy that stays safe when the world stops looking like the training data.
hero.lede: I'm Raj Vamsi, an Integrated B.Tech + M.Tech student at ABV-IIITM Gwalior and a research intern at the University of Virginia. I work where learned models meet safety guarantees - neural control barrier functions, imitation learning and real-to-sim driving in CARLA.

quote.text: Treat "it works in this scenario" as the beginning of a question rather than the end of one.
